content.text:
Add a guest cap and waitlist to the Soirée Planner.

The venue's fire code caps attendance at 120 guests. When the
confirmed guest list (including plus-ones) reaches 120, new RSVPs go
to a waitlist instead. Show a "spots remaining" count, and show
waitlisted guests in their own section in order of signup.
I’ll inspect the app structure and RSVP flow first so the cap logic lands in the right layer and the UI stays consistent.

The project is a small static app with `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `script.js`; there’s an unrelated settings change already present, so I’ll leave it alone. Next I’m reading the current markup and state logic before editing.

I’m going to keep the rule simple and conservative: only “Attending” RSVPs consume capacity, a named plus-one counts as one extra guest, and an attending RSVP is waitlisted if the full party would exceed the 120-person cap. Regrets can still be recorded without affecting capacity.
